name: oven
displayName: OVEN — Open Vector Editor with New Features
description: View plasmid sequences in VS Code and collect primers across files into one orderable list

oven.viewType.description: Default view type when a sequence is opened.

oven.readOnly.markdownDescription: Open sequences with editing locked. While locked, the **Create** menu (New Feature, New Primer, ...) is hidden entirely. You can always toggle the padlock in the editor toolbar for a single file.

oven.allowSequenceEditing.markdownDescription: Allow the DNA bases themselves to be edited, including **Change Amino Acid** on a translation. When off, annotations can be created and edited but the sequence cannot be cut, pasted over, complemented or deleted.

oven.autoAddCreatedPrimers.markdownDescription: Automatically add a primer to the Primer Cart when you create one with **Create -> New Primer**.

oven.maxItems.description: Maximum number of primers the cart will hold. Adds beyond this are refused rather than silently dropping older entries.

oven.inventoryPath.markdownDescription: Path to a primer inventory `.xlsx` or `.csv`, used to flag cart primers that you have already ordered. Supports `~` and `${workspaceFolder}`. Leave empty to disable cross-referencing.

oven.inventorySheet.description: Worksheet name to read from an .xlsx inventory. Leave empty to use the first sheet.

oven.inventoryNameColumn.markdownDescription: Header of the column holding primer names or IDs. Leave empty to use the first column. The header must match the file exactly, including any special characters such as `°` or `μ`; if it does not match, the error message lists the headers actually found.

oven.inventorySequenceColumn.markdownDescription: Header of the column holding primer sequences. Leave empty to use the second column. Matching against the cart is by exact sequence, ignoring case and whitespace.

oven.sequenceCopyIncludesName.description: Format used by the "Copy sequences" button.
enumDescriptions: Name and sequence separated by a tab, one per line.

oven.searchMinAnneal.markdownDescription: Minimum number of bases at a primer's 3' end that must match the template exactly for it to count as a hit. Lower finds more and noisier; higher is stricter.

oven.searchFullLengthOnly.markdownDescription: Start each primer search with **100% match only** ticked, hiding primers whose 5' tail is absent from the template.

oven.searchMaxHits.description: Safety cap on how many primer-search hits are returned. Overflow is reported in the results header.

oven.inventoryAliasColumn.markdownDescription: Header of an optional column shown alongside each search hit. Leave empty to use a column named `Alias` if one exists; a missing column is never an error.

oven.inventoryDescriptionColumn.markdownDescription: Header of an optional free-text column from your inventory, shown as the last column of the search results and labelled with the header itself. Name any column you like — `Purpose`, `Ordered by`, `Freezer box`. Leave empty to use a column named `Description` if one exists; a missing column is never an error, and the column is hidden entirely when there is nothing to put in it.

oven.showSelectionStatsByDefault.markdownDescription: Turn on Open Vector Editor's **Melting Temp of Selection** and **Percent GC Content of Selection** status-bar items the first time a sequence is opened. Both can still be toggled from the **View** menu afterwards, and your choice there wins.

oven.mafftPath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `mafft` executable. Leave empty to search your `PATH`, then the usual Homebrew and conda locations (including named conda environments, which are never on VS Code's `PATH`). Run **Primer Cart: Check MAFFT Installation** to see what was found. Install MAFFT with `brew install mafft` or `conda install -c bioconda mafft`.

oven.mafftArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to MAFFT. `--auto` lets MAFFT pick a strategy; use `--localpair --maxiterate 1000` for L-INS-i accuracy, or `--retree 1` for speed on large read sets. `--adjustdirection`, `--preservecase` and `--quiet` are always added.

oven.alignTrimQuality.markdownDescription: Trim trace ends below this Phred quality before aligning, so end noise does not dominate the mismatch count. Set to `0` to align the full base calls. Only affects `.ab1` reads, which are the only ones carrying quality scores.

oven.alignMaxReads.markdownDescription: Maximum number of reads in one alignment. Reads beyond this are ignored, with a note in the panel.

oven.searchPrimersHotkey.markdownDescription: Keyboard shortcut that opens **Primer Search**, in Open Vector Editor's own notation — see `oven.newPrimerHotkey` for the notation. It searches the selection when there is one and the whole plasmid otherwise, exactly like the right-click entry, and the binding is shown beside that entry. **Reopen the file for a change to take effect.** `mod+shift+f` is deliberately not the default: VS Code binds it to Search: Find in Files at the workbench level, which resolves before a webview sees the key. Set to an empty string for no shortcut.

oven.newPrimerHotkey.markdownDescription: Keyboard shortcut that opens the **New Primer** panel, in Open Vector Editor's own notation: `mod` is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere, joined with `+` — for example `mod+shift+k`, `alt+p`, `mod+alt+n`. The binding is shown next to **New Primer** in the menus, so a change here is visible where you would look for it. **Reopen the file for a change to take effect.** Avoid combinations VS Code binds at the workbench level (`mod+j`, `mod+shift+n`): those are resolved before a webview sees the key. Set to an empty string for no shortcut.

scripts.pretest: yarn run lint && node scripts/patches.js check
